description: This file defines the class PlatformCapsData within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It provides methods to access platform capabilities and device information, as well as an inner JsonRpc class for handling JSON-RPC communication. The file references external interfaces such as PluginHost::IShell and other classes for JSON-RPC messaging.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Main class providing access to platform capabilities and device information, including nested JSON-RPC communication handling.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc
classes.description: Helper class managing JSON-RPC client connections for communication with the service.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Inner class providing methods to invoke JSON-RPC calls, handle message creation, sending, and response parsing.

methods.name: AddDashExclusionList
methods.description: Populates a list with dash exclusion criteria.

methods.name: GetQuirks
methods.description: Returns a list of device quirks.

methods.name: SupportsTrueSD
methods.description: Checks if the device supports True SD.

methods.name: CanMixPCMWithSurround
methods.description: Indicates if PCM can be mixed with Surround sound.

methods.name: GetFirmwareUpdateDisabled
methods.description: Checks if firmware updates are disabled.

methods.name: DeviceCapsFeatures
methods.description: Returns device capability features as a map.

methods.name: XCALSessionTokenAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the XCAL session token is available.

methods.name: getAvailablePlugins
methods.description: Returns available device plugins as a map.
